title_sq: OKAZION! SHITEN APARTAMENTE TEK FUSHA E AVIACIONIT
description_sq:
Shiten Apartamente 1+1 dhe 2+1 ne nje kompleks ne ndertim. Objekti eshte ne faze karabina dhe murature.
Shiten me cmim okazion 1450€/m², firma po shet mbi 1600€/m².
Mundesi blerje me keste.
Ndodhet tek ish fusha e Aviacionit.
title_en: OPPORTUNITY! APARTMENTS FOR SALE NEAR THE AVIATION FIELD
description_en: 1+1 and 2+1 apartments for sale in a complex under construction. The object is in the carabiner and masonry phase. They are sold at a bargain price of €1,450/m², the company is selling over €1,600/m². Cash purchase option. It is located at the former Aviation field.
